title: Payroll & Administration Officer / Independent Operation Officer
description:
Payroll & Administration Officer / Independent Operations OfficerRole Description

* Manage daily payroll and administrative activities to ensure accurate records, efficient processes, and smooth business operations.
* Prepare, review, and process payroll information, including employee attendance, overtime, allowances, deductions, and other compensation details.
* Maintain employee records, payroll documentation, attendance reports, and confidential personnel information with a high level of accuracy.
* Assist with payroll reconciliation, salary calculations, statutory contributions, and compliance with applicable employment and payroll regulations.
* Coordinate employee onboarding documentation, leave records, benefits administration, and other HR-related administrative tasks.
* Handle general administrative duties, including document preparation, filing, data entry, correspondence, and office resource coordination.
* Monitor daily operational activities, identify process gaps, and implement practical solutions to improve efficiency and productivity.
* Coordinate with internal departments, external service providers, and relevant stakeholders to ensure timely completion of administrative and operational tasks.
* Prepare operational reports, maintain accurate databases, and support management with documentation and routine business analysis.
* Manage assigned tasks independently, prioritize workloads, resolve routine operational issues, and ensure compliance with company policies and procedures.
* Support internal process improvements, resource planning, and the implementation of administrative controls to enhance operational effectiveness.
* Handle sensitive information responsibly and maintain confidentiality, professionalism, and integrity in all work-related activities.

Qualifications

* Diploma or bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, Human Resource Management, or a related field.
* Understanding of payroll processing, attendance management, employee records, and general administrative procedures.
* Familiarity with payroll systems, Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, and relevant business administration software.
* Knowledge of statutory payroll requirements, employment regulations, and employee benefits administration is an advantage.
* Strong numerical, analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills, with excellent attention to detail.
* Ability to work independently, manage multiple responsibilities, and complete tasks accurately within established deadlines.
* Good communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to coordinate effectively across departments.
* Strong sense of responsibility, discretion, and integrity when handling confidential payroll and business information.
* Ability to adapt to changing operational needs, identify potential issues, and recommend practical improvements.
* A proactive, flexible, and detail-oriented approach to administrative management and daily business operations.

title: Plant Manager
description:
**Role Description**
The Plant Manager role at RK CONSTRUCTION is a part-time, remote position responsible for overseeing daily plant-related activities and ensuring efficient operations. The Plant Manager will coordinate plant operations, monitor production schedules, and support manufacturing processes to meet project timelines and quality standards. This role includes analyzing operational performance, implementing process improvements, and collaborating with project and site teams to ensure materials and equipment are available as needed. The Plant Manager will also help maintain safety and compliance standards, prepare basic reports on plant performance, and communicate regularly with leadership to align plant activities with overall construction project requirements.

**Qualifications**

* Candidates should possess skills in Plant Management and Plant Operations.
* Candidates should possess skills in Operations Management and Production Planning.
* Candidates should possess skills in Manufacturing Operations.
* Experience in construction, infrastructure, or related industrial environments is beneficial.
* Strong analytical, organizational, and communication skills, with the ability to manage remote responsibilities effectively.
* Proven ability to work safely, follow regulatory and company guidelines, and support continuous improvement initiatives.
* Relevant technical or engineering education, or equivalent practical experience in plant or operations management, is preferred.
